findings.desc: packages/main/src/core/closeout-trust.ts:606-675 — The promised separation between review retention and artifact authority is not mechanically enforced. classifyCurrentCloseoutArtifactForReviewRetention accepts a same-UID-forgeable causal receipt and keeps the signed review current, while validateCurrentCloseoutArtifact always returns invalid because latestValidCloseoutReceipt is deliberately null. rg shows validateCurrentCloseoutArtifact has no production gate consumer (only closeout-trust-smoke); production artifact readers consume test/summary/delivery/live-smoke evidence through their separate readers without canonical writer provenance. Therefore a local actor can replace an artifact and co-commit a forged causal receipt, preserve the review, and reach the ordinary artifact consumer without the re-review that previously supplied the only writer-authority boundary. Either add an actual independently authoritative admissibility check to every registered artifact consumer (isolated signature/capability or equivalent), or keep such post-review writes review-invalidating; comments/tests that an unused helper remains fail-closed are insufficient.

packages/main/src/handlers/done-prepare.ts:1442-1468 — The new convergence counters do not measure the closeout history they claim to prove. metadataRollbacks and humanConfirmations only regex the current invocation step text; reviewerReattestations counts current blocking runbook rows (which is necessarily zero on PASS), not new reviewer runs/passes; successfulCloseout is only the final snapshot. A story that already rolled back, received a human story_resume, or re-attested reviewers before this invocation still renders all zero. The smoke test constructs the same final snapshot, so it cannot catch this. Capture a closeout baseline and derive counts from persisted signed process events/review-run/pass identities and validation receipts over that interval, including initial/final phase/round/receipt identity, then assert those measured counts before PASS.

packages/main/src/handlers/validate-concept.ts:120-155 — scanDeletedSymbols is still a line regex keyed only by declaration kind+name, not the declaration/file/scope/signature identity required by CHK-003. It ignores class methods/constructors and collapses overloads/same-name declarations. Repro against current dist: a diff replacing `export function f(x: string): string;` with `export function f(x: number): number;` returns [], and a changed method signature also returns []; thus removal of one overload/signature can be hidden by any added same-name declaration. The focused smoke passes because it tests only an unmatched removed overload and explicitly narrows methods/constructors out of scope, contradicting the must verification intents. Implement declaration-aware identity (or an explicit fail-closed parser/ambiguity diagnostic) and cover same-name overload/scope/signature replacement, methods, and constructors.
